message.content:
An editorial magazine cover features the large black text "TEMPO" across the top. Below, a headline in white sans-serif font reads "BAYANG-BAYANG TIM BAYANGAN," followed by smaller text.

The central illustration depicts two light-skinned men in light-colored, short-sleeved shirts. On the left, a man with dark hair sits atop a golden-brown horse statue. On the right, a stouter man wearing a songkok sits atop another similar horse statue. Both horses are rearing up on their hind legs, facing each other.

A literal transformation is shown: the horses are not real animals but hollow shells or costumes. Dark-clothed human figures are positioned underneath, physically lifting and supporting the horse forms and the men sitting on them. One figure on the left is visible from the waist down, wearing sandals, while another figure on the right is crouched, supporting the weight from below. The man on the left grips the horse’s reins, while the man on the right holds a rod connected to his horse. The background is a flat, olive-brown color. Small text and a barcode are located in the bottom-left corner.
